notes.title: GIVEAWAY: Steam Gift Cards & 100+ Keys
notes.content:
UPD:

Friends, giveaway results:



Everyone who participated in the giveaway can write to darkfantasy.gamedev@gmail.com (with comment number and profile) and get the key for participate!


Gift Steam cards receive comments (random.org):
#135 - https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198215377421
#333 - https://steamcommunity.com/id/Antropophagus
#616 - https://steamcommunity.com/id/shlohmoo

Add to friends [url=]https://steamcommunity.com/id/publisheroftheworld/ and get your gifts!

Thank you all for participating! Good luck in future giveaways.


Receiving a prize is actual for the next five days! You will receive a key within a week. Who will write later than May 14 - 21:00 Moscow, will not receive a prize!


Thank you for such positive feedback for the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325919/520f3a3ee9bb38e297523095d56fddcf4cd4caa3.png

Today we would like to start a Giveaway:
 $10 Steam Gift Cards x3

 100+ Steam Keys


These prizes are Waiting For You! :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298114/c80a81600953a4c14234bf0ffa73c6a4d970e458.png

Friends, to take part in the giveaway, you should:
[olist]
Add the game to your Steam Wishlist (if it is not already in your Steam library)

Share this announcement with all who you knows! :)
Click "Share" under this news, then "Share directly to my status", write something and click "Post"

Tell us your opinion about the game in the comments under this announcement! We will be very happy to hear it from you!
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298114/6eafadb50d5228926cad543fe55acb1c4a5350c0.png
We will announce the results of the giveaway on May 9 at 21:00 Moscow time! Good luck!

Guys, we also would like to remind you in a friendly manner that we, as you are waiting for, and really want to get that trading cards and add new levels to the game.

But the development of the game in terms of adding trading cards, adding new levels, features and much more depends entirely on your activity - the number of additions of the game to the wishlist, the activity on the store page & in the discussions of the game, the number of game launches, the time spent in the game.

All this affects to how fast we'll get trading cards and this helps us to get them! Thank you for understanding! :)

We can do it together!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40325919/4d9723c807ac5102572ce1f2270f917a29c9f6fe.png

We will be very grateful if you tell your friends about the game, write your opinion in comments or reviews and add it to your wishlist if you're liked it!


Thank you! :)
